print_basics.skill: Print fixed characters, the alphabet or digits with write

program_args.skill: Use argc and argv: print, pick or count the arguments

string_basics.skill: Rewrite the basic string functions: length, copy, compare, print, reverse

pointers.skill: Change the caller's values through pointers

char_transform.skill: Transform each character of a string: rotation, case, mirror, repetition, replacement

words.skill: Find, extract, clean up or reorder the words of a string

case_style.skill: Change the writing style of words: camelCase, snake_case, capitals

char_sets.skill: Compare the characters of two strings: found in both, in one only, in order

number_parse.skill: Turn a string into an integer, in base 10 or another base

number_print.skill: Print an integer in base 10 or another base, or turn it into a string

arithmetic.skill: Integer arithmetic: operations, gcd, lcm, prime numbers, tables

bits.skill: Read and change the bits of a byte or an integer

allocation.skill: Allocate memory: copy a string, build an array of numbers

split.skill: Split a string into an allocated array of words

int_arrays.skill: Go through or sort an array of integers

linked_lists.skill: Go through and change a linked list

grids.skill: Explore a 2D grid of characters, like a flood fill
